name: v6-nagelkerke-r2-py
description: Federated Nagelkerke's R2 for an already-fitted logistic regression model. Exact federation via summed log-likelihoods (additive over independent observations).

functions.name: central
functions.description: Coordinator: aggregates per-node log-likelihood statistics and computes Cox-Snell and Nagelkerke R2 for the given fitted model.

arguments.name: features
arguments.description: Predictor columns, in the same order as coefficients

arguments.name: coefficients
arguments.description: Fitted model coefficients, same length/order as features

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Privacy guard: skip nodes with fewer samples

functions.name: partial_loglik
functions.description: Per-node: local sample size, outcome sum, and fitted-model log-likelihood contribution. Returns aggregates only.

arguments.name: features
arguments.description: Predictor columns, in the same order as coefficients

arguments.name: coefficients
arguments.description: Fitted model coefficients, same length/order as features
